text: Reject idea statuses the project does not define
description: The backend accepted any status string, so 'human-dependency' (typo) was stored on 2db9fb3e and silently fell out of prioritization, hygiene and stop policies. Creating an idea or changing its status now requires one of meta.statuses or 'archived'; an unchanged state is not rechecked so legacy ideas stay editable.
